waive.TypeOK: Shape check only: no behaviour change breaks it without also breaking a property above it.

mutations.name: takes-over-a-tag-being-ended
mutations.why: open() hands a reopened session the tag of its closed tab while the core is still ending that tag's processes: the new tab's omp is spawned with it and the end in flight kills it.

mutations.name: a-quit-ends-the-tabs-it-tears-down
mutations.why: close() without the frozen check: a quit disposes every tab, so every open session's dev server would be ended at each quit and update restart.

mutations.name: sweep-ignores-the-restored-layout
mutations.why: The launch's sweep ends every tag the last launch left, also those of sessions whose tab came back.

mutations.name: sweep-ends-a-tag-a-tab-holds
mutations.why: The launch's sweep goes by the file alone, not by who holds a tag now: a tab started before the sweep ran (a session opened right after launch) loses its omp.

mutations.name: a-released-tab-leaves-what-the-last-launch-left
mutations.why: Without sessionReleased: a restored tab closed before it ever started keeps its session's tag in the file with nobody to end it until the next launch.

mutations.name: a-failed-end-forgets-the-tag
mutations.why: An end the core could not answer drops the tag from the file: its processes still run and nothing can ever name them again.

mutations.name: a-retry-ends-a-tag-a-tab-took-over
mutations.why: The retry of an end that left something running fires a minute later without looking again: a session reopened meanwhile took the tag over, and the retry kills its omp.
